title: The work between games
lede: Screen it, program it, fuel it.

vertical.title: Measure my vertical
vertical.line: Prop your phone up, jump three times. About a minute.

mirror.title: The Mirror
mirror.line: A live coach for squat, lunge, hinge and push-up. Every number is an estimate.

drills.line: Wake-up and landing drills on camera. Nothing is sent.

programming.lineNone: No coach yet. An invite link brings their plan.

library.title: Exercise library
library.line: Every exercise, with cues and faults. Search or ask.

iron.title: Iron Paradise
iron.line: The gym floor. Lift, jump, and put a number on it.

playbook.title: The Playbook
playbook.line: Ten chapters on how the body moves.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.line: Meals keyed to the numbers you enter.

squads.title: Squads and teams
squads.line: Group streaks and a weekly league. No messages.

roster.title: Your roster
roster.line: Who you coach, what they did, who is drifting.

combine.line: Run a tryout station by station, then rank it.

combines.title: Your combines
combines.line: Your combine numbers, and where you placed.

standing.title: Where you stand
standing.line: PRQ, your grade, and what has moved.

sprint.title: Sprint speed
